name: Sprouted
tagline: A team community-garden platform on Streamlit, Flask and MySQL, where my work was the seed data and personas, persona-specific routes and pages, and moving seeding into the Docker Compose boot.
overview: Sprouted is a full-stack community garden management platform. The README lists Jackson Zheng as a team member. The stack includes Python, Streamlit frontend, Flask REST API, MySQL, Docker, and Docker Compose. The app supports community garden operations through database-backed workflows, REST routes, volunteer pages, role navigation, and seeded persona data. Exact active commit dates and Jackson-authored commits should be verified.

timeline.how: Added schema/seed material from the shared project source into the repo.
Refactored seed.py so it could retrieve/print database data without manual prompting.
Updated Home/nav to reflect personas/pages and helped resolve navigation conflicts.
Helped combine persona pages, role nav, and backend table changes into the main app.
Worked through API route and field mapping issues across persona pages.
Added realistic persona data so role-based pages had data to display.
Fixed the UI so there was only one proper button per Lucia flow.
Changed seed script and Docker Compose flow so seeding ran during boot instead of requiring a separate manual exec step.
